title: Acquirer: Group 4 Falck; Target: Wackenhut Corrections Corporation Australia Pty Ltd
targets: Wackenhut Corrections Corporation Australia Pty Ltd

body_sections.Summary: Group 4 Falck proposes to acquire a 57% interest in Wackenhut Corrections Corporation.
body_sections.Market definition: The market is the national market for custodial services.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The Panel considered that the proposed acquisition would not lead to a substantial lessening of competition in the national market for supply of custodial services for the following reasons: - there appear to be at least two substantial companies which will compete against the post-acquisition entity; - barriers to entry do not appear to be high; - the threat of vertical integration is real; - the countervailing power of customers, state and federal governments, is high; and - the parties also claim that their respective Australian operations will be bound by the terms of the proposed acquisition agreement which state that they must remain in competition in Australia.
